تغلغلت (form IIq)
# تَغَلْغَلْتُ (taḡalḡaltu) /ta.ɣal.ɣal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# تَغَلْغَلْتَ (taḡalḡalta) /ta.ɣal.ɣal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# تَغَلْغَلْتِ (taḡalḡalti) /ta.ɣal.ɣal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَغَلْغَلَ (taḡalḡala)
# تَغَلْغَلَتْ (taḡalḡalat) /ta.ɣal.ɣa.lat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
